learner_operation: Eliminate x (possibly swap rows); set the remaining affine y coefficient to zero; inspect the residual constant to distinguish contradiction from a redundant equation, then choose the resulting k.

fixed_features.feature: Two variables and one unique parameter answer
fixed_features.justification: The observed elimination leaves one affine coefficient. A unique singular parameter fits the five-choice assignment response. Asking for independent systems would generally require all other k values and a different response contract.

fixed_features.feature: Inconsistency in the simpler band, dependence in the hard band
fixed_features.justification: The authored easy simplification isolates a contradiction after one integer elimination. Hard source solutions additionally interpret a redundant equation and free variable, often with swaps/fractional arithmetic. Keeping these reasoning workloads within their source bands is an instructional constraint; it does not fix the numerical root, answer rank or position.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Coefficients and affine offsets determine signed integer/rational roots; shifted families admit zero.
answer_roles.observed: Exact boundary records now retain zero across all four affected authored and observed families; ordinary signed roots vary.

answer_roles.role: Correct answer numeric rank and displayed position
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Any of five ranks/positions; correctness must follow the equations.
answer_roles.observed: Current offset bank chooses rank independently before coefficient resampling. Fresh and exact batch ranks/positions vary; prior signed-extreme rule fails. Historical records retain old cue.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Preserve observed y-affine parameter with inconsistency for simpler band, dependence for hard source band.
answer_roles.observed: All observed families replay, including fractional elimination with bare k. Classification fixed per source-supported difficulty; constants follow target.

coverage.result: 18/18 replay; all 17 captured five-choice banks preserved. Canonical solution uses equivalent +(-2) instead of -2 notation.
Exact batch and fresh easy banks tested separately before/after shared delivery; current bank ranks are not locked by sign.
Strict old failures reproduced; current package passes explicit zero roots in four affected families and source q-74691.

counterfactuals.change: At seed 681704 keep a=1,b=2,c=1,d=2,u=1,e=3 fixed; v 3 -> 1 and 4.
counterfactuals.expected: Roots 1 -> 3 and 0; elimination, final answer and native grading update together.
counterfactuals.observed: Exact printed prompts/matrices/conclusions give 1,3,0. Actual native grader tests all five choices including old k=1 in new-root bank. UI renders each.
counterfactuals.justification: Elimination root is (db/a-v)/u, so changing v requires reconsidering k.

counterfactuals.change: At same seed and coefficients change second RHS 3 -> 4.
counterfactuals.observed: Printed system and solution update residual, preserve k=1; all actual grader choices tested and pair rendered.
counterfactuals.justification: Both residual constants remain nonzero, so their magnitudes do not affect singular parameter.
